title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A student chats with your assistant on Monday and the session ends. On Wednesday they open a new session and ask, "Did my safety training go through?" Nothing was saved anywhere. What does the model have to go on?

options.text: Only the text in the new call, which has nothing about Monday
The model's own memory of Monday's chat, stored inside the model
A summary the model wrote itself at the end of Monday's session
The student's training data, which the model picked up in training

items.stem: Your assistant sends 1,000 tokens of fixed text plus a 50-token question in call 1. The model replies with a 100-token tool request, and the tool returns 500 tokens. Call 2 re-sends everything so far. How many input tokens does call 2 contain?
A student asks which glue is safe in the 3D printer enclosure. The only place that answer lives is a 90-page manual. Which design is best for a small model budget?

options.text: Search an index of the manual and load only the best pages
Paste the whole manual into every call so nothing is missed
Save the whole manual as a note and load it at every start
Rely on the model to recall the manual from its training

items.stem: In one or two sentences: a teammate says the model "learns" each student's booking habits by chatting with them. What really carries those habits from one session to the next, and who handles it?
A long chat has filled most of the context window with old tool results the assistant no longer needs. Name one action that reduces the context, and say why a larger window is not the better fix.
